Good Will Hunting (1997) Cast Then and Now

2 February 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Good Will Hunting, the 1997 drama that launched Matt Damon and Ben Affleck to stardom and earned Robin Williams an Academy Award. Powered by raw, authentic performances, the film remains a fan favourite for its heart, humour, and insight into the human condition.

But what became of the incredible cast that brought this beloved story to life? Let's catch up with the unforgettable stars of Good Will Hunting then and now:

Robin Williams (Dr. Sean Maguire)

Age in 1997: 46

Advertisement

Current: Passed Away in 2014 at Age 63

  • Compassionate, unconventional therapist
  • Recognises Will's hidden potential
  • Used humour and wisdom to guide Will's journey of self-discovery

In arguably his finest dramatic role, Robin Williams brings warmth, humour, and poignant wisdom to the character of Dr. Sean Maguire. As Will Hunting's therapist, he eschews clinical detachment in favour of earnest connection. Where others see liability and resistance, Sean recognises the glimmer of genius and a wounded heart. Rightly recognised with an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor

Sadly, Robin Williams passed away in 2014 at the age of 63. His inspirational performances as Dr. Sean Maguire and in countless other films continue to move and delight audiences worldwide.

Matt Damon (Will Hunting)

Age in 1997: 27

Current Age: 54

Advertisement
  • A brilliant, emotionally damaged young man
  • Solace in solving complex math problems
  • Struggled to connect with others

As the troubled genius Will Hunting, Matt Damon delivered a star-making performance that cemented his reputation as one of the finest actors of his generation. Will's journey of confronting his traumatic past and embracing love remains an inspirational story that still resonates with viewers today.

Ben Affleck (Chuckie Sullivan)

Age in 1997: 25

Current Age: 52

  • Will's loyal childhood best friend
  • Represents Will's blue-collar roots
  • Unwavering support, despite its abrasive nature

Ben Affleck demonstrated his acting chops as Chuckie Sullivan, Will's foul-mouthed but steadfast best friend. Their friendship added emotional weight to the film, highlighting the crossroads Will faced between his humble upbringing and a promising future.

Stellan Skarsgård (Professor Gerald Lambeau)

Age in 1997: 46

Current Age: 73

  • Prestigious mathematician
  • Recognises Will's talent, frustrated by his attitude
  • Pushes Will to embrace his gifts and responsibility

Veteran Swedish actor Stellan Skarsgård brought nuance and gravitas to his portrayal of Professor Lambeau. Though often at odds, Lambeau becomes invested in nurturing Will's mathematical brilliance. Their clashes force Will to consider the greater purpose of his talents.

Casey Affleck (Morgan O'Mally)

Age in 1997: 22

Current Age: 49

  • Will's friend
  • Highlights the choices Will must make

In an early role, Casey Affleck played Morgan O’Mally, one of Will's bar friends leading a directionless life that contrasts with Will’s promise. Their interactions and those with Morgan's brother highlight the critical decisions Will must make about his future path and the complicated social forces he must navigate.

Cole Hauser (Billy McBride)

Age in 1997: 22

Current Age: 49

  • Friend of Chuckie and Will
  • A cautionary tale about unchecked anger
  • Urges Will to meet challenges maturely

As Chuckie’s volatile friend Billy McBride, Cole Hauser delivered an intense performance in a small but pivotal role. His explosive nature served as a reminder of what sort of life Will has lived and what path his life will take should he shun his gifts.

Minnie Driver (Skylar Satenstein)

Age in 1997: 27

Current Age: 54

  • Challenges Will's views on relationships
  • A glimpse of a future with emotional connection

Minnie Driver is delightful as Skylar, an unconventional Harvard student who opens Will’s mind and heart to the possibility of love. The emotional transparency of their connection provides Will with an inspiring model for a life rich in intimacy.

The exceptional cast of Good Will Hunting stands the test of time, with its principal stars still enjoying thriving acting careers today. While we have sadly lost Robin Williams, his iconic performances continue to inspire viewers. The film captured lightning in a bottle—a moving story depicted by actors at the peak of their abilities.

FAQ

Are Ben Affleck and Matt Damon still friends?

Yes, Ben Affleck and Matt Damon are still close friends. They met as kids in the 1980s and have maintained a strong friendship since then. Their friendship has been essential and defining in both of their lives.

Did Matt Damon and Ben Affleck really write Good Will Hunting?

Yes, Matt Damon and Ben Affleck really wrote Good Will Hunting. They co-wrote the screenplay for the film, which won them an Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay in 1998.

How did Matt Damon and Ben Affleck get Robin Williams?

Matt Damon and Ben Affleck got Robin Williams to star in Good Will Hunting through the traditional process of casting. After completing the script for the film, they went through the standard Hollywood procedure of sending it to agents and waiting for responses. Eventually, Robin Williams expressed interest in the project and was cast in the film.

What part did Cole Hauser have in Good Will Hunting?

Cole Hauser played the role of Billy McBride, one of the friends of the main character, Will Hunting, in Good Will Hunting.
